verdict.rationale: Veriff provides test integrations that are auto-created on onboarding, don't count toward paid usage, and allow triggering decisions without real verifications—effectively a sandbox mode—plus a free 15-day trial and Postman collection for testing. However, this is aimed at human developers configuring integrations, not framed as an AI-agent-friendly sandbox, and there's no explicit 'sandbox environment' branding or isolated test data guarantees beyond usage exemption. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment documentation distinct from production, confirmation that test data is fully isolated from production data stores, and any AI-native testing framing.
